zh: 先选玩法，再选一位伙伴。
en: Choose a game and then a companion.

zh: 双方各自打乱暗子，翻开后还是自己人。
en: Each side shuffles its own pieces. Reveals keep their color.

zh: 红黑三十子一起打乱；翻开可能变成对方的子。
en: All thirty pieces are mixed. A reveal may belong to your opponent.

zh: 这里还没有棋桌，先在设施里建一张吧。
en: No chess table yet. Build one in Facilities first.

zh: 棋桌还没建好，去建一下吧。
en: The chess table is unfinished. Build it first.

zh: 棋桌在主岛，回到主岛再入座吧。
en: The chess table is on the main island. Return there to take a seat.

zh: 上一局还在，先继续或结束它吧。
en: A game is still here. Continue or finish it first.

zh: 先停下手上的事、放好随身物品，再来入座吧。
en: Finish your task and put carried items away before taking a seat.

zh: 棋桌有人正在用，等她们下完吧。
en: The table is in use. Wait until their game finishes.

zh: 棋桌还没建好，周围被占用了；请在空地另摆一张棋桌。
en: This unfinished table is blocked. Place another chess table on open ground.
